home.hero_quote_continue: Tell me more about my project

about.p1: I design and deliver complete websites and web applications for local businesses and SMEs: from design to going live, with a focus on speed, security and ease of use.
about.p2: I work on varied projects: showcase websites, online ordering and payment, custom tools. I work remotely and adapt to each client's needs.
about.simplon_text: Web & Mobile Web Developer diploma — my first immersion into the world of code. That's where it all started: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, backend basics.
about.python_text: A short one-month course to explore another paradigm — logic, scripting, automation. A detour that broadened my way of thinking about code.
about.wcs_text: Intensive Fullstack JavaScript bootcamp — React, Node.js, databases, team projects. The level rises, projects become real.
about.self_text: After the courses, I continued alone: deploying on VPS, securing servers, building projects from A to Z. Try, fail, understand, start again. That's where I really learned.
about.val_security_desc: Encrypted connection, locked-down access and backups: your site and your customers' data stay protected.
about.val_perf_desc: A site that loads fast, including on mobile.
about.val_responsive_desc: Every site is tested on mobile, tablet and desktop.
about.val_deploy_desc: I put the site online and look after it: hosting, HTTPS certificate, monitoring.

items.q: How does the free mockup work?
items.a: You fill in a short form in a few steps and choose when I call you. That call lets me understand your business and what you like. Within 72 working hours of that call, I send you a mockup of your home page. You look at it at your own pace and decide afterwards, with no commitment.

items.q: How much does a website cost?
items.a: The Showcase pack starts at €490. The Showcase + pack (booking, online payment, admin area, multilingual) starts at €990. Maintenance, with secure hosting, backups and updates, is €50 per month. I give you the exact price before we start.

items.q: How long until my site is live?
items.a: It depends on the pack and on how quickly you approve each step. I confirm the timeline during our first conversation, before any commitment.
No. Everything is done remotely, by phone, WhatsApp and email, anywhere in France. If you are in Toulouse, we can also meet in person.

items.q: What does the €50 per month maintenance include?
items.a: With the rise of AI, automated attacks find security flaws much faster: a site that is no longer updated quickly becomes a target. Maintenance is an option for peace of mind. It includes secure hosting, the domain name, security updates, regular backups, site monitoring and responsive support if anything goes wrong. It can be cancelled with one month's notice.

items.q: Does the site really belong to me?
items.a: Yes. Once the final payment is received, the site and its texts are yours, and the domain name is registered in your name. Maintenance is optional. At any time, on simple request, I hand over the files of your site, free of charge, so you can host it wherever you like.
